page.overview:
Who is Lisa Simpson?

LiseJake BoymanTruth TellerLie SmellerLady Penelope Ariel PonyweatherLisa Bouvier (by herself)Lisa B. (by Nelson Muntz)Raven Crow NeversmilesBig MaggiePrincess HelveticaSister Suspect Lisa FlandersMoaning LisaQueen HelveticaNancy CluelessMary-AnneSnickerpuss SimpsonSpringfield's Answer to a Question No One Asked (By Ned Flanders)Lois SanbornH.S.H/Her Serene HighnessThe Princess LisaPrincess of SpringfieldBaroness SimpsonWindsongJulesSeñorita Ugly The Great Lisa SimpsonL-Simpson-JazzgirlHoney PieTootsie PopShe-BartNew Kid (by Devin)}}

Former: BabysitterFounder of SpringFaceKids News anchor

Parents: Homer Simpson and Marge SimpsonEx Stepmother: Amber Simpson (Deceased)Siblings: Bart Simpson and Maggie SimpsonGrandparents: Abe Simpson II, Mona Simpson (Deceased), Clancy Bouvier (Deceased), and Jacqueline BouvierAunts: Selma Bouvier and Patty BouvierHalf Aunt/Uncle: Abbey and Herbert PowellCousins: Jessica Simpson and Ling Bouvier (Adopted)Other Relatives: Simpson Family, Bouvier Family, Gurney Family}}

Lisa Marie Simpson (born May 9 or April 2) is a charismatic 8-year-old girl who exceeds the standard achievement level of children her age. Not to everyone's surprise, she is also the moral centre of her family. In her upbringing, Lisa lacks parental involvement from Homer and Marge, which leads to hobbies such as playing saxophone and guitar, riding and caring for horses, and an interest in advanced studies. In school, Lisa's popularity is affected by those who view her as a geeky overachiever, which leaves her with only a few friends. Lisa Simpson is a smart, witty, independent girl who focuses on her goals and strives to reach her potential, and at age 8, she is already a member of MENSA with an IQ of 159.

Also known as: Lisa.
